explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem is about `Theta χ ε c := ∑ i, subst χ (c i) * ε i`, a definition that belongs to this library. It says that if multiplying each `ε i` by `a` gives `Theta χ ε (v i)`, then multiplying any `Theta χ ε c` by `a` gives `Theta χ ε (fun k => ∑ i, c i * v i k)`. The proof works only from the library's own lemmas `Theta_mul_left` and `Theta_finset_sum`, plus generic glue (`Finset.mul_sum`, `Finset.sum_congr`, `Finset.sum_apply`, `ring`). It applies no single Mathlib declaration. Mathlib has no notion that matches `Theta` (a combination twisted by `MvPowerSeries.subst`), so the mathematical content sits in the library's own definitions.
